decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system has required substantial specialized engineering and certification investment, so escalation favors keeping it despite limited promotion.
As a core interior luminaire with its own page and public launch, it is central and visibly committed, making a drop hard to justify.
The recently promoted microprismatic pendant aligns with the human-centric direction and has public launch promotion, so sunk costs and commitment favor keeping.
The marine searchlight has little visible promotion and is not central to the announced direction, so limited investment and weak public commitment make dropping more likely.
